messages:
Jordan: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — can someone clarify our default audit log retention and how that works for Private deployments (VPC/on-prem)?
Priya: TL;DR: default is 90 days in the hosted control plane; for Private we provide an export pipeline and customers control retention. SOC2 controls map to evidence exports, not forced retention on customer infra.
Miguel: For Dedicated/Private we offer an optional automated export to an S3-compatible endpoint (cross-region replication is supported but must be enabled in the deployment config). Note: cross-region copies add egress/copy costs.
Aisha: Related question — BYOK/KMS rotation: can we rotate keys without causing inference failures? What's the recommended pattern?
Priya: Yes — recommend staged rotation: provision new key + grant decrypt to both keys during a transition window, then retire old key. Our control plane supports dual-key acceptance for ~24-72h to avoid downtime. See snippet: `kms.rotateKey(customerKeyId, {gracePeriodHours: 48})`.
Tom: Does audit log contain request payloads/prompts? For GDPR/compliance we need to know what gets logged by default.
Priya: Default logs include metadata: request_id, model, route, latency, status, and token counts. Full prompt content is NOT logged by default for hosted unless customer opts into request logging; we redact PII by pattern matching when request-logging is enabled. For Private deployments, logging behavior follows the customer's export/collector config.
Jordan: For SOC2/ISO audits — what artifacts can we produce on short notice?
Leah: We maintain an evidence pack in the compliance repo: control matrices, policy docs, SOC2 readiness checklist, recent pen-test summary, and sample audit logs (redacted). We can produce historical exports on request (subject to retention). Ping me and I'll open a ticket with Security Ops.
ComplianceBot: Automated note: SOC2 evidence request template created -> #support-ticket-12345 (use for tracking).
Aisha: Thanks. Can we get a 30m follow-up w/ infra + security to confirm migration steps for customers who want <90d retention?
Priya: Yes — I'll set up a meeting. Action items: 1) Priya to schedule follow-up (calendar invite + agenda), 2) Miguel to produce short doc on export config + cost implications, 3) Leah to surface evidence export runbook, 4) Engineering to confirm KMS rotation APIs + example. Posting meeting prep links in thread shortly. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Awesome, thanks everyone.
Tom: +1 — please include example curl for the export config in the doc.
Priya: Will do.
